All Bizzness Sports / Subprocessors

Service
providers.

This page identifies the limited third-party services used to deliver, protect, and support the public All Bizzness Sports website.

Last reviewed: October 1, 2026

Cloudflare Pages

Purpose: website hosting, content delivery, DNS, TLS, security, and protection against abusive traffic.

Cloudflare may process technical request information such as IP address, browser and device details, requested URL, timestamps, referring URL, and security events to provide these services. Cloudflare’s own privacy notice, service terms, and data-processing materials govern its processing.

ESPN sports-data API

Purpose: the optional live scoreboard feature requests current game and team data from the external sports-data endpoint used by the homepage.

The browser makes the request when the scoreboard feature runs. The provider may receive ordinary network and request data and controls its own retention, privacy, and service terms. The site does not send a user account, payment information, or a site-hosted form submission to this endpoint.

Linked platforms

Facebook, YouTube, Davidson Digital Design, and linked team or league pages are outbound destinations, not processors appointed by All Bizzness Sports for the website. Once a visitor follows one of those links, the destination’s own privacy, cookie, and service rules apply.

What is not used

All Bizzness Sports does not currently use optional analytics, advertising pixels, a newsletter system, a user-account database, or a payment processor. If that changes, this page and the Privacy Policy should be updated before the new service is used.

Read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for the broader site rules.
